items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: I take a few lessons from Loretta Teo

ctx.x: Too bad we didn't bring the copies. I got the… Speaking of Buddy Petit, I believe Harold told us that he had you to change over to… Yeah, I played with him. Another instrument. And then I…
Keep me up shaggy for him. Well, then I take a few lessons from Loretta Teo and he went to New York. You remember when he went to New York. What kind of a sax, what sax was it?
